purpose: Small reproducible Chinese/English engineering corpus, not production semantic quality acceptance.

documents.text: 个人知识库只供所有者使用。组织 OWNER 管理组织知识库，组织成员需要显式 READ、WRITE 或 MANAGE 授权。Agent 绑定本身不授予知识库权限。

The index repair worker restores an active Milvus generation from verified stored embedding vectors. It never calls an embedding provider. Missing or corrupt vector objects require an explicitly authorized rebuild.
解析由独立 Apache Tika 服务处理文字 PDF 和 DOCX。PDF 保留真实页码，DOCX 不伪造页码；OCR 与嵌入附件不在本轮解析范围。

Deleting a document first clears its PostgreSQL active-generation pointer. Durable tombstones clean Milvus and objects after leases expire, verify twice, and periodically remove late writes. Superseded-generation cleanup does not delete the current document.
